items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Myself, Pete Brown, Don Frye, of course John Kirby... you left Kirby... I proved myself inside of two years... John Kirby, he wasn't a bandleader at all.

ctx.x: Oh, it was about two years.
Yes. Myself, Pete Brown, Don Frye, of course John Kirby, and he had Frankie Newton and I forget whether we used...
I think Buster Bailey came in there.
